Issued to: Assiut Power Generation Station
Procedure: Test procedures using secondary circuit injection

sections_en.text: This document sets out the test steps for the protection device mentioned above. The first draft of this document was prepared by Eng. Mahmoud Ahmed Mahmoud at Assiut Power Station, Upper Egypt Electricity Production Company. The field test was carried out on 19 October 2002 by Eng. Ali Hussein Farrag and Mahmoud Faisal Mohamed.
The unit is out of service.
Fence off the work area and place warning signs.
Follow the occupational safety and health instructions for the safety of personnel and equipment.

Voltage and frequency injection test set, Multi-Amp Corp, model FG-50/MD-E

rows: Insert Test plug type RTXH18 into Test socket type RTXP 18 on the relay (a81H).
Short-circuit points (1, 13) on Test plug type RTXH 18.
Inject 100 V at 50 cycles/second from the Multi-Amp Corp test set onto points (9, 10) on the Test plug.
Raise the frequency until the indication appears.
Connect the Start leads of the time measuring instrument to the High to Low points on the Multi-Amp Corp injection test set.
Connect the Stop leads of the time measuring instrument to point (2) on the Test plug and point (16) on element RXSF1 (319).
Switch the Multi-Amp Corp voltage and frequency injection test set from Low to High.
Reduce the voltage to zero, then switch off the injection test set.
Withdraw Test plug type RTXH 18 from Test socket type RTXP 18 on the relay (a81H).

Egyptian Electricity Holding Company
Maintenance Procedures Information System
Maintenance Procedures Information System
 | Transformer Stations | Maintenance Procedures
Document No.: OFR-002-r0a | Equipment: Testing the generator over-frequency protection device x81H RXFE 4 ABB
Issued to: Assiut Power Generation Station
Status: Approved
Approval date: 07 September 2003 | Procedure: Test procedures using secondary circuit injection
Next review date: September 2003
Introduction
This document sets out the test steps for the protection device mentioned above. The first draft of this document was prepared by Eng. Mahmoud Ahmed Mahmoud at Assiut Power Station, Upper Egypt Electricity Production Company. The field test was carried out on 19 October 2002 by Eng. Ali Hussein Farrag and Mahmoud Faisal Mohamed.
Safety Precautions
The unit is out of service.
Open the work order.
Fence off the work area and place warning signs.
Follow the occupational safety and health instructions for the safety of personnel and equipment.
The unit is out of service.
Open the work order.
Fence off the work area and place warning signs.
Follow the occupational safety and health instructions for the safety of personnel and equipment.
Tools, Instruments and Equipment Used
Test plug, model RTXH 18
V-A AC voltage measuring instrument, model YOKOGAWA
Voltage and frequency injection test set, Multi-Amp Corp, model FG-50/MD-E
Millisecond Counter (Timer ) Type MCS - 5N
Test leads
Test plug, model RTXH 18
Procedures to be Carried Out
Insert Test plug type RTXH18 into Test socket type RTXP 18 on the relay (a81H). | 1
Short-circuit points (1, 13) on Test plug type RTXH 18. | 2
Inject 100 V at 50 cycles/second from the Multi-Amp Corp test set onto points (9, 10) on the Test plug. | 3
Raise the frequency until the indication appears. | 4
Record the frequency value. | 5
Connect the Start leads of the time measuring instrument to the High to Low points on the Multi-Amp Corp injection test set. | 6
Connect the Stop leads of the time measuring instrument to point (2) on the Test plug and point (16) on element RXSF1 (319). | 7
Switch the Multi-Amp Corp voltage and frequency injection test set from Low to High. | 8
Record the time value. | 9
Reduce the voltage to zero, then switch off the injection test set. | 10
Withdraw Test plug type RTXH 18 from Test socket type RTXP 18 on the relay (a81H). | 11
Reset the relay (a81H). | 12
